site_name: Phase 2, Located on the Corner of Boord Street and Dreadnought Street, Greenwich, SE10 0PF
description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with planning consent (24/0995/F) dated 27/11/2024 solely relating to phase 2 (Purpose Built Student Accommodation Phase) to allow: No increases to the overall height of the building or number of floors but clarification on the floor numbers to remove reference to mezzanines.Alterations to the building envelope, increasing by one full brick on all sides.Increase in Student rooms from 340 to 353;Increased number of accessible bedrooms/studios to meet requirements for inclusive design as required by condition 69.Reduction in cycle parking ratio from 0.75 spaces per bed to 0.5 spaces per bed resulting in 177 spaces for students, 4 no. spaces for staff, 10 e-bike spaces, and 9 no. external spaces for visitors.Internal alterations to cycle store locations and plant rooms spaces on levels 1, 2 and 3.Introduced green roof and external terrace on proposed level 3 for students with relocation of generator now placed internally within the building at level 1.Owing to the changes highlighted above and requested alterations to the wording to condition 68, the following conditions 2 (approved drawings), 3 (quantum of development), 4 (quantum of development - height of buildings and floorspace), 54 (Fire Statement), 58 (Green/Brown Roofs and Walls) and 68 (Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan) will require amendments.
